_note: Lao interface catalogue. A partial overlay over en.json by contract. Built by tmp/lo/i18n.py, which asserts completeness against en.json, that every placeholder survives, that no category-Cf character is present, and that every Lao run parses through the same reader the pack rows go through. The studio, export and preview keys appended after that build were written by hand and are not yet in tmp/lo/i18n.py, so its completeness assertion needs the two deliberate gaps allowed for: preview.lockDate and preview.lockTime are left out on purpose, because the lock-screen mock now takes its sample date and time from CLDR and the English in en.json is only a floor for locales Intl has never heard of. ແຖບ does double duty as the head/foot band and as the tab, so the tab is ແຖບສີ wherever one sentence has to name both. Message-screen pass (board.slow, board.switch*, display.*): display.roman is ຕົວອັກສອນຂອງເຈົ້າເອງ «your own letters», because the line it switches is the card's say column -- the respelling in the reader's own script, as field.respell / field.title.respell already describe it -- and not the Latin romanisation; IPA stays ໄອພີເອ as in field.ipa; display.speak and display.turn name the controls as ປຸ່ມ, as editor.noListenerText already does. Most used and speak-on-tap pass (26 keys), written by hand like the studio keys and so not yet in tmp/lo/i18n.py; every Lao run was put through tmp/lo/g2p.py the way that builder's assertion does, and none holds a Cf character. board.tapSpeaks is ອ່ານອອກສຽງເມື່ອແຕະ, board.speak's ອ່ານອອກສຽງ with the file's tap verb ແຕະ (about.unset, beacon.dismiss); display.tapSpeaks opens with the same words. This file sets a name off with spaces, never quotation marks (display.polite, arrange.removeTitle), so display.tapNoVoice makes the mode its subject as the verbal noun ການອ່ານອອກສຽງເມື່ອແຕະ, with check.voice's ສຽງເວົ້າສຳລັບ{language}. Press is ກົດ (board.arrangeHint). The file has no grid for buttons (the ຕາ of format.arrangementTitle.mixed is a table's), so 'the grid stays' is ໜ້າຈໍຍັງຄືເກົ່າ. The counts are ຈຳນວນຄັ້ງທີ່ກົດ, never ມິເຕີ (the corpus's taxi meter) or ໃບບິນ (its bill); reset is about.set's ລ້າງ. The windows are numerals, 7 ມື້ທີ່ຜ່ານມາ / 30 ມື້ທີ່ຜ່ານມາ / 12 ເດືອນທີ່ຜ່ານມາ / ທັງໝົດ, the spans the code counts, on the N-ປີທີ່ຜ່ານມາ shape lo.wikipedia uses; ອາທິດແລ້ວ would be the calendar week, and ອາທິດ is also the day in ວັນອາທິດ. usage.scopeOne hangs the name on ພາສາ as board.wrongPair does (ສະເພາະພາສາ {language}) -- ICU's Lao names never carry ພາສາ -- rather than addTerm.inLanguage's ເປັນ {language}, which with ນັບ reads as counting in that language; usage.scopeAll is board.toGallery's ພາສາທັງໝົດ and usage.resetNo arrange.removeNo's ຮັກສາໄວ້. No first-person pronoun and no polite particle anywhere in these keys.
